positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead for the Carrier External team developing Arrive EDGE for Carriers.
Arrive EDGE allows our carrier partners to view, manage, and book freight.

Key Technologies:
- Typescript
- React
- Graphql

- Hired and lead a new team working on greenfield product offerings for our external client base
- Developed a comprehensive new React component library for our new Design Language system
- Improved performance of legacy internal software by reducing bundle sizes up to 40%, eliminating perceived wait times, and removing excessive page flickering and re-renders
- Spearheaded efforts to increase testing and general stability for legacy internal software
- Maintained ~80% test coverage in greenfield projects and taught junior engineers good testing practices

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Formerly known as Spredfast.

- Lead project planning and coordinated with BE engineers to plan larger cross-functional efforts
- Coordinated closely with Product and Design to scope and plan FE projects
- Architected new calendar views with an eye towards scalability and ease of future additions
- Wrote extensive onboarding documentation for future team members
- Mentored junior engineers
- Developed performant algorithms in web workers to calculate when ads are actually running
- Reduced Tech Debt through large dependency upgrades ex: React, Webpack, and Flow
- Delivered a new SKU (Social Vault) allowing companies to securely give users native access to social accounts without handing out their passwords
- Developed a system of reusable components for building out governance screens which increased development speed by 60% 
- Implemented a complete redesign of the Content Center module for Hack Week 2018 bringing the product inline with current designs and reducing the complexity of further development
- Built, maintained, and advocated for components in our shared React component library
- Rebuilt legacy PHTML and CanJS admin and governance in React for Hack Week 2017 allowing us to pull the administration area out of the legacy monolith and into a new more maintainable and product agnostic repository

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
- Restructured toy problem curriculum by creating instructional lectures on algorithmic thinking and CS fundamentals as well as organizing problems in increasing difficulty to better build and cement skills
- Improved student performance on toy problems up to 3 times through improved curriculum and student one on one meetings.
- Duties included: Answering student questions on assignments, interviewing prospective students, participating in conversations about student wellbeing, and leading the morning toy problem hour.
